sections.label: Automotive Templates
sections.description: Supercar, off-road, motorsport and motorcycle website templates. Plain HTML and CSS you can copy straight into a project.

sections.label: UI Components & Backgrounds
sections.description: Hero sections, backgrounds and reusable website components.

sections.label: Anime Assets
sections.description: Original anime-style scenes and effects, drawn in code. Every item is original work with its license shown; no third-party characters or art.

items.title: Vortex GT
items.summary: A bold supercar landing page with a real-time 3D hero car you can drag to rotate, a paint switcher, and a scroll-driven night drive: neon skyline parallax, speed streaks, a live speedometer and gear counter, then models, engineering and a reserve form.
fonts: System font stack (Bahnschrift / Arial Narrow fallback)

license.name: MIT
license.author: MotionShelf
license.notes: Original layout, copy, inline SVG artwork and generated scene tiles. Code written with AI assistance. 'Vortex' is a fictional brand. No third-party images, fonts, logos or trademarks. The scroll scene loads GSAP and ScrollTrigger from cdnjs under GSAP's standard no-charge license; they are not bundled in these files. The optional 3D hero uses the unbranded Car Concept model (CC BY 4.0, see Asset sources and credits), loaded with three.js from esm.sh; without WebGL it falls back to the original SVG car.

items.title: Ridgeback X
items.summary: An off-road SUV site with a desert crossing you scroll through: layered mountains and dunes, a rising sun, dust, a body that pitches over terrain, and altitude and incline readouts, plus capability, terrain modes, trims and a test-drive form.
fonts: System serif stack (Iowan Old Style / Palatino / Georgia) and system sans

license.name: MIT
license.author: MotionShelf
license.notes: Original layout, copy, inline SVG artwork and generated scene tiles. Code written with AI assistance. 'Ridgeback' is a fictional brand. Specifications are invented. No third-party images, fonts, logos or trademarks. The scroll scene loads GSAP and ScrollTrigger from cdnjs under GSAP's standard no-charge license; they are not bundled in these files.

items.title: Redline Racing
items.summary: A high-contrast motorsport team site with a scroll-driven qualifying lap: grandstands and kerbs rushing past, speed streaks, lap clock, rev lights and sector bars, a chequered finish, then standings, drivers and the calendar.
fonts: System font stack (Bahnschrift / Arial Narrow fallback)

items.title: Kestrel M9
items.summary: A dusk-lit motorcycle site with a coastal ride you scroll through: palms strobing past, a sun sinking into the sea, a bike that leans into the bends with live lean-angle and speed readouts, plus lineup, technology and a test-ride form.
fonts: System font stack (Futura / Century Gothic fallback)

items.title: Sakura Dusk
items.summary: A painted-style dusk scene with eight parallax layers: sky, setting sun, mountains, a shrine gate, a blossom tree, a lone traveller and falling petals. Scrolling carries the scene from sunset to a starry night with glowing lanterns.

items.title: Neon Rain
items.summary: A rainy anime-style night city: layered skyline with lit windows, neon signs that wake up and flicker, an elevated train, a wet street with reflections and a traveller under an umbrella. Scrolling walks the street while the rain thickens.

items.title: Impact Frames
items.summary: Anime and manga effects in pure CSS: radial speed lines, halftone screens, an impact burst, focus lines and a sound-word ticker, plus a Hit button that fires the burst, flash and shake. Four effect panels you can copy one at a time.
